outcomeNote: Ameimar's rule and Rav Ashi's practice collecting in full.

segments.he: אָמַר אַמֵּימָר: מַאן דְּדָאֵין דִּינָא דִגְרָמֵי — מַגְבֵּי בֵּיהּ דְּמֵי שְׁטָרָא מְעַלְּיָא. מַאן דְּלָא דָּאֵין דִּינָא דְגַרְמֵי, מַגְבֵּי בֵּיהּ דְּמֵי נְיָירָא בְּעָלְמָא.
segments.en: «Ameimar said: One who judges cases of liability for indirect damage» and maintains that someone whose actions cause damage is obligated to pay, even if he has not directly harmed another, «collects in this» case «the value» of «the proper document.» Since by forgiving the loan the creditor voided the document and caused the purchaser financial loss, he must compensate the purchaser for the amount recorded in the document. «One who does not judge cases of liability for indirect damage collects in this» case «only the value of the paper» on which the document was written.

segments.he: הֲוָה עוֹבָדָא וְכַפְיֵיהּ רַפְרָם לְרַב אָשֵׁי, וְאַגְבִּי בֵּיהּ כִּי כְשׁוּרָא לְצַלְמֵי.
segments.en: The Gemara relates that «there was an incident» like this one, «and Rafram pressured Rav Ashi» by means of verbal persuasion to render an unequivocal ruling in this matter, «and» Rav Ashi «collected in this» case «as» if he damaged «a beam» used «for» crafting «a sculpture,» i.e., the full value of the debt listed in the promissory note.

moves.cueHe: אמר אמימר: מאן דדאין דינא דגרמי
moves.summary: Whoever judges indirect damage makes the forgiving seller pay the note's full value; otherwise only the paper.

moves.cueHe: הוה עובדא וכפייה רפרם לרב אשי
moves.summary: Rafram pressed Rav Ashi, who collected the full value.

edges.about: Rafram pressed Rav Ashi to rule on the forgiven sold note
